findings.title: Privileged source install executes candidate-controlled checkout before an authenticated release boundary
findings.required_fix: Remove the source checkout as privileged first-install authority; permit privileged first install only through the OS-validated signed MSIX release path and keep development setup non-elevated.

findings.title: Recursive installer ACL and owner changes can traverse descendant reparse points
findings.required_fix: Remove the unsafe privileged source-tree hardening path; no recursive ACL mutation may follow a checkout-controlled link or conceal partial failure.

findings.title: Elevated source installer accepts and executes user-writable per-user Python runtimes
findings.required_fix: Never execute a user-writable interpreter at high integrity; route privileged installation through the signed MSIX boundary and keep source/developer execution unelevated.

findings.title: Threshold release signer jobs execute repository-controlled code while exportable signing keys are present
findings.required_fix: Move signing behind immutable independently maintained code or a non-exportable HSM/KMS boundary that accepts only a canonical statement digest; candidate repository code must not share a process or workspace with signer credentials.

findings.title: Concurrent resilience self-tests can delete live diagnostics and corrupt environment routing
findings.required_fix: Capture and validate exact temporary roots, restore every prior environment value exactly, and serialize any unavoidable process-environment mutation with deterministic concurrency tests.

findings.title: Security Scan Center path validation can be bypassed by file, directory, or root link/reparse swaps
findings.required_fix: Bind validation and bounded reads to no-follow handles, preserve selected-root and volume identity, and never reopen a validated target by pathname for YARA.

findings.title: Combined Scan Center runs can display Complete while the requested Defender component failed
findings.required_fix: Aggregate every requested component status and bounded error; report Complete only when all requested scanners completed, preserving partial and cancellation states.
